description: Mastery-tier corporate procurement leadership module examining administrative regulatory penal defense: eu deforestation regulation (eudr).

Eliminate common Czech interference errors in administrative regulatory penal defense: eu deforestation regulation (eudr)

questions.prompt: The international arbitral tribunal mandated that the respondent enterprise _____ full restitution for latent mechanical defaults.

explanations.correct: High-register mandative subjunctive requires base form 'furnish' after 'mandated that'.
explanations.wrong_A: Indicative 'furnishes' violates formal legal subjunctive syntax.
explanations.wrong_C: 'shall furnish' is indicative/modal, less standard than pure subjunctive in mandative clauses.
explanations.wrong_D: 'must to furnish' is completely ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: V mezinárodním právu a arbitrážních nálezech se po slovesech nařízení používá subjunktiv se základním tvarem: 'mandated that the respondent furnish'.

questions.prompt: Seldom _____ witnessed such profound material degradation without prior ultrasonic acoustic warning.

explanations.correct: Negative adverb 'Seldom' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion: 'have our forensic metallurgists witnessed'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'our forensic metallurgists have' lacks required subject-auxiliary inversion.
explanations.wrong_B: 'did... had' is an ungrammatical double past.

questions.cz_learning_point: Záporné příslovce 'Seldom' na začátku věty vyžaduje přísnou inverzi pomocného slovesa a podmětu: 'Seldom have our experts witnessed...'.
questions.workplace_track: Quality Specifications, Food Safety & Non-Conformance Claims

questions.prompt: _____ the sovereign ministry to repudiate the bilateral procurement treaty, international offset commitments would immediately trigger arbitration.

explanations.correct: Inverted Second Conditional with 'Were [subject] to [infinitive]' expresses formal hypothetical future contingency.
explanations.wrong_B: 'Had' forms a Third Conditional (past counterfactual), incompatible with 'to repudiate'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Should' expresses tentative probability with bare infinitive, not 'to repudiate'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Inverze druhého kondicionálu v diplomatických smlouvách: 'Were the ministry to repudiate...' = 'Kdyby ministerstvo vypovědělo...'.
questions.workplace_track: Quality Specifications, Food Safety & Non-Conformance Claims

questions.prompt: Statutory covenants stipulate that intellectual property rights in respect of the minimum order quantity (MOQ) pallet allocation _____ vested solely in the sovereign contracting authority.

explanations.correct: Mandative subjunctive after 'stipulate that' takes base form 'remain'.
explanations.wrong_A: Indicative 'remains' violates the subjunctive convention in statutory covenants.
explanations.wrong_B: Future 'will remain' is non-standard in formal contract drafting.
explanations.wrong_C: Continuous 'are remaining' cannot express permanent legal status.

questions.cz_learning_point: Smluvní ujednání (stipulate that) vyžadují základní tvar slovesa: 'stipulate that rights remain vested'.
questions.workplace_track: Quality Specifications, Food Safety & Non-Conformance Claims

questions.prompt: _____ irreversible metallurgical micro-shear, the component fractured along the primary grain boundary.

explanations.correct: Perfect active participle 'Having sustained' correctly expresses prior causal damage leading to subsequent fracture.
explanations.wrong_A: Present participle 'Sustaining' implies simultaneous action rather than prior cause.
explanations.wrong_B: Passive 'Being sustained' misassigns voice to the component.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předpřítomné participium 'Having sustained' (utrpěvši nevratné poškození) vyjadřuje příčinu, která časově předcházela prasknutí.
questions.workplace_track: Quality Specifications, Food Safety & Non-Conformance Claims

questions.prompt: The panel rejected the supplier's defense, _____ the catastrophic loss stemmed exclusively from improper operational maintenance.

explanations.correct: Present participle 'holding that' functions as a supplementary clause expressing the legal rationale of the governing body.
explanations.wrong_A: Past tense 'held that' cannot connect two main clauses without coordinating conjunction.
explanations.wrong_C: Infinitive 'to hold that' implies purpose rather than contemporaneous legal holding.
explanations.wrong_D: 'having held' implies the holding occurred prior to the rejection.

questions.cz_learning_point: Právní formulace 'holding that...' (konstatujíc, že...) se v anglických soudních a arbitrážních nálezech používá pro odůvodnění rozhodnutí.
questions.workplace_track: Quality Specifications, Food Safety & Non-Conformance Claims

questions.prompt: Had timely notification of latent defect been served, compensatory damages _____ legally recoverable under Swiss federal law.

explanations.correct: Third Conditional consequence clause requires 'would have been' to match past counterfactual premise 'Had notification been served'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'would be' refers to present result, but recovery relates to past arbitral award.
explanations.wrong_B: 'had been' is past perfect indicative, not a modal conditional consequence.
explanations.wrong_C: 'will be' is future indicative, completely incompatible with past counterfactual condition.

questions.cz_learning_point: Dokončený děj v minulém kondicionálu (Third Conditional): 'Had it been served, damages would have been recoverable'.
questions.workplace_track: Quality Specifications, Food Safety & Non-Conformance Claims

questions.prompt: Foremost among the tribunal's findings _____ the persistent failure of senior management to enforce standard operating procedures.

explanations.correct: Fronted prepositional phrase triggers subject-verb inversion; singular subject 'failure' requires singular verb 'was'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'were' incorrectly agrees with plural 'findings', but the real postposed subject is singular 'failure'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'has been' conflicts with the completed past narrative of the inquiry.
explanations.wrong_D: 'did' is an auxiliary that cannot function as a copula.

questions.cz_learning_point: Pozor na shodu podmětu s přísudkem při inverzi: 'Foremost among findings was the failure...' — podmět je jednotné číslo 'failure', proto sloveso musí být 'was' (nikoli *were*).
questions.workplace_track: Quality Specifications, Food Safety & Non-Conformance Claims

questions.prompt: The multinational joint venture established a binding dispute mechanism, pursuant _____ all technical conflicts must be referred to ICC Paris.

explanations.correct: Formal legal phrase 'pursuant to' requires 'to which' when modifying the mechanism.
explanations.wrong_A: 'pursuant of' is incorrect legal English; 'pursuant' strictly takes 'to'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'for which' alters the meaning from legal conformance to purpose.

questions.cz_learning_point: Právní vazba 'pursuant to which' (v souladu s nímž / na jehož základě) je ustálená formule mezinárodních smluv.
questions.workplace_track: Quality Specifications, Food Safety & Non-Conformance Claims

questions.prompt: Unless the corporate steering committee _____ comprehensive capital reallocation by Q4, institutional market share will irreversibly erode.

explanations.correct: Conditional clause with 'Unless' requires Present Simple ('authorizes') in high-register executive projections.
explanations.wrong_A: Future modal 'will' is prohibited inside the conditional 'Unless' clause.
explanations.wrong_C: 'would' creates an ungrammatical hypothetical mismatch with predictive 'will erode'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'shall to' is ungrammatical; modal 'shall' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: I na nejvyšší manažerské úrovni platí základní pravidlo: po spojce 'Unless' se nesmí použít 'will' (*Unless the committee will authorize*). Použijte přítomný čas: 'Unless the committee authorizes'.
